items.title: Samsung Electronics To Implement Largest-Ever Shareholder Return in 2026, Estimated at KRW 90 to 110 Trillion
items.what_happened: Samsung Electronics’ Board of Directors convened today and approved a shareholder return plan for 2026, estimated at approximately KRW 90 trillion to KRW 110 trillion. items.title: Samsung’s Human-Centered Design Wins IDEA and Red Dot Design Award 2026
